description:
Q’AQ’ Lab was created by a student team working across Data Science Engineering, Industrial Chemical Engineering, Microbiology, and Biochemistry.

Combustion evidence is more than a data problem. Experimental conditions must be structured correctly, physical and chemical behavior must be interpreted carefully, and the limits of each result must remain visible.

- Data Science Engineering shaped the data structure, comparison logic, interface, and application development.

- Industrial Chemical Engineering reviewed the combustion variables, experimental domain, and scientific validity of the results.

- Microbiology and Biochemistry contributed research on smoke and aerosol behavior and helped define the limits of biological interpretation.

Together, we built Q’AQ’ Lab to make NASA research easier for students to find, compare, understand, and cite without losing the context of the original experiments.
